index_line: - [[q-acoustics-5020]] — 6 Ω, 5" ported, LW ±3.3 dB, f3 103 Hz, min 3.4 Ω / EPDR 1.7 Ω, pref 3.6 (Erin)
source_index_lines: - [[eac-q-acoustics-5020]] — Erin's Audio Corner Klippel review, 2023-06-02 (Tier A)
- [[mfr-q-acoustics-5020]] — Q Acoustics US product page (Tier C)
brand_notes: Q Acoustics 3000i-series standmounts (3020i, 3030i) remain on the maker's US site at $349.96 / $499.96 per pair though What Hi-Fi? says 3000c replaced them (3020c launched). 5000 series (5010 $999, 5020 $1,199 pair) uses C3 curved-cone driver and sealed isolated tweeter; Erin's 5020 data show a treble-heavy response and 3.4 ohm minimum. All models rated 6 ohm with claimed minimums 3.3-4 ohm. Maker claims 88 dB for 3000i vs measured 85.6-86.1 dB (nrc-q-acoustics-3020i, asr-q-acoustics-3020i); 5020 claim 87.9 vs 86.7 measured (eac-q-acoustics-5020).
takeaways: Klippel LW ±3.3 dB, f3 103 Hz, treble heavy per Erin
Min impedance 3.4 Ω, EPDR 1.7 Ω: demanding, flagged effectively-4ohm
THD ~0.9% at 86 dB, ~3.2% at 96 dB near 100-140 Hz (graph-read); little compression to 102 dB above 80 Hz
US maker price $1,199 vs TAS $899 in 2024
Listening critics praise balance and detail, conflicting with measured colouration
conflicts: TAS 'flat' / Trusted 'warm' vs Erin 'treble heavy' LW ±3.3 dB
Claimed 53 Hz -6 dB vs computed f6 74 Hz
